en.headline: Soft Thunder opens Central branch with exclusive banoffee egg tart
en.dek: The local bakery’s third outlet at Man Yee Building began trading today, offering a limited banana-toffee tart and tiramisu cloud latte alongside its usual range.
body: Local bakery Soft Thunder opened its Central branch on Friday at Shop 106-107 on the first floor of Man Yee Building, 68 Des Voeux Road Central.
The shop, the brand’s third after Kennedy Town and Wan Chai, features about 20 seats and a communal long table. Opening hours are 7:30am to 7:30pm on weekdays and 8am to 7:30pm at weekends.

A branch exclusive is the banoffee egg tart priced at HK$23, with banana-infused custard, Italian chocolate, coffee, fresh banana and caramel. The menu also includes a tiramisu cloud latte at HK$43 made with mascarpone foam, plus sandwiches and burgers.
Soft Thunder, which first opened in 2021, is known for its egg tarts and other pastries. The Central site serves light meals and speciality coffee in addition to the bakery items.

zh.headline: Soft Thunder中環分店今日開業 推限定香蕉太妃蛋撕
zh.dek: 本地洪焙店第三間分店進駐萬宜大廈，新推香蕉太妃蛋撕及提拉米蘇雲朵拿鐵。
body: 本地洪焙品牌Soft Thunder周五於中環德輔道中68號萬宜大廈商場一樓106至107號舖開設分店。
這是品牌繼堅尼地城及灣仔後的第三間店舖，座位約有20個，設有共用長桌。單日至五營業時間為上午7時30分至下午7時30分，周末則由上午8時開始。
分店限定出品為售價HK$23的香蕉太妃蛋撕，蛋撕混合香蕉、意大利朱古力及咖啡風味，中央藏有香蕉及焦糖。菜單亦有售價HK$43的提拉米蘇雲朵拿鐵，以馬斯卡彭起奶蓋製作，另有三文治及漢堡。
Soft Thunder於2021年創立，以蛋撕等洪焙聞名。中環店除洪焙外，亦提供輕食及特色咖啡。
